Granting global scope access (A) is too broad, and admin role exceptions (D) violate the customer's policy.

questions.stem: When an employee contacts HR, they speak in terms of lifecycle events. From an HR perspective, that event gets translated into several HR services that need to be performed. Of the following items, which would be considered a lifecycle event?
questions.explanation: Having a baby is a lifecycle event because it triggers multiple HR services: benefits enrollment changes, parental leave, payroll adjustments, etc. A lifecycle event represents a significant life or career change that requires coordinated work across multiple HR services. Direct Deposit Setup (A), PTO Inquiry (C), and Tuition Reimbursement (D) are individual HR services, not lifecycle events.

questions.stem: All ServiceNow web traffic uses which data protocol to ensure data is always TLS encrypted in transit.
questions.explanation: All ServiceNow web traffic uses HTTPS to ensure data is always TLS encrypted in transit. HTTPS is the standard secure web protocol that wraps HTTP communication in TLS/SSL encryption, protecting data as it travels between the user's browser and the ServiceNow instance. REST (A) and SOAP (C) are API protocols, not transport security. HTTP (B) is unencrypted.

questions.stem: Scenario: Alex is a member of the HR Tier 1 group which grants him the HR Basic [sn_hr_core.basic] role. He is going to be out of the office for a few days and wants to use granular delegation to allow his friend Amy to complete his tasks. Amy is not yet a member of any HR groups, but hopes to transfer into HR one day. Will granular delegation work for this purpose?

options.text: Yes. Granular delegation will automatically grant the necessary roles
Yes. Granular delegation will automatically add Amy to the HR Tier 1 group where she will inherit the role.
Partially. Granular delegation will allow Amy access to the HR Tasks, but not to the HR Case itself.
No. Granular delegation does not change a delegate's access to records.

questions.explanation: Granular delegation does not change a delegate's access to records. It only allows task routing — Amy would receive notifications and task assignments, but without the HR Basic role, she cannot actually view or work on HR cases and tasks. Granular delegation was designed to forward work, not grant security access. Amy would need proper HR roles independently.

questions.stem: Which Lifecycle Event activity type enables you to manage the dependencies or order of activities within an activity set?
questions.explanation: Activity containers manage dependencies and ordering of activities within an activity set. They group related activities and enforce sequential execution, ensuring predecessor activities complete before successor activities begin. This is the Lifecycle Event activity type specifically designed to handle complex activity ordering and dependency chains.

questions.stem: If all Can Edit Journey permissions are selected on the Journey configuration, which of the following users are allowed to make changes to the existing Journey? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: When all Can Edit Journey permissions are selected, the journey owner (A) and the mentor (C) are allowed to make changes to the existing Journey. The journey owner has full edit rights to manage stages and tasks, and the mentor can modify tasks within their purview. The employee (B) and admin (D) are not explicitly listed as Can Edit journey permission holders.

questions.stem: Lifecycle Events includes an activity set that can be used to cancel and revert work done in a lifecycle event case. What is this process called?
questions.explanation: The process of canceling and reverting work done in a lifecycle event case is called Rescind. The rescind activity set enables administrators to undo completed activities, such as reverting equipment provisioning or workplace setup, when a lifecycle event needs to be reversed (e.g., new hire decides not to join).

questions.stem: When configuring a Lifecycle Event, which of the following is used to define the relationships between fields in various tables?
questions.explanation: Activity Field Mapping defines the relationships between fields in various tables when configuring a Lifecycle Event. It maps fields from the lifecycle event case to child cases, tasks, or other records, ensuring data flows correctly between the parent lifecycle event and its generated activities. Trigger conditions (A) control when activities fire, not field relationships.

questions.stem: Which of the following features allows employees to delegate their tasks to other employees for specific date and time ranges based on delegation rules?
questions.explanation: Granular Delegation allows employees to delegate their tasks to other employees for specific date and time ranges based on delegation rules. It provides targeted task forwarding without transferring security access or roles. Delegates receive work items during the defined period while the original assignee is unavailable.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of Journey designer?

options.text: It tracks the progress of Lifecycle Events and onboarding cases using the dashboards.
It creates templates for plan and to-do tasks that managers, employees, and mentors can access.
It manages the dependencies of activities within an activity set.
It combines Lifecycle Event cases and Journey Accelerator action plans.

questions.explanation: Journey Designer combines Lifecycle Event cases and Journey Accelerator action plans into a unified experience. It provides a comprehensive view that integrates the automated lifecycle event activities with the personalized journey plans created by managers, creating a complete onboarding or transition experience for employees.

questions.stem: Which Security control option uses the context of the data within the record to grant and/or restrict access?
questions.explanation: Access Control Lists (ACLs) use the context of data within a record to grant or restrict access. ACLs evaluate conditions based on record field values, user roles, and scripts to make row-level and field-level access decisions. This contextual approach means access can vary depending on the specific data in each record, not just the user's role.

questions.stem: Which HRSD application automates and streamlines employee onboarding and other activities across departments?
questions.explanation: Lifecycle Events is the HRSD application that automates and streamlines employee onboarding and other transitional activities across departments. It coordinates activities, approvals, and tasks across multiple teams (HR, IT, Facilities, etc.) when employees experience lifecycle changes like onboarding, offboarding, transfers, or leaves of absence.

questions.stem: What are the functions of a journey template owner? (Choose three.)

options.text: Manage the order and flow of the journey stages and tasks
Create task templates for their audience in a simple, user-friendly experience
Add owners and approvers to journey configurations
Change only the task templates that they own
Maintain oversight of journey templates and approval flows

questions.explanation: Journey template owner functions include: managing the order and flow of journey stages and tasks (A), creating task templates for their audience (B), and changing only the task templates that they own (D). Adding owners/approvers (C) and maintaining oversight of approval flows (E) are administrative functions beyond what a template owner does.

questions.stem: What variable type is included to configure the HTML document template?
questions.explanation: The Customized Variable type is included to configure the HTML document template. Customized variables allow administrators to define dynamic content placeholders within HTML templates that are populated with data from ServiceNow records when the document is generated. Label (B), Multi Row (C), and Masked (D) variables serve different purposes.

questions.stem: Which plugin when paired with HRSD, delivers storage space, filing system, and functionality to purge and retrieve documents?
questions.explanation: Employee Document Management is the plugin that delivers storage space, a filing system, and functionality to purge and retrieve documents when paired with HRSD. It provides cloud-based document storage, document type classification, retention policies, legal holds, and secure access controls for employee documents.

questions.stem: What is the minimum role required to view confidential data associated with the HR Profile?
questions.explanation: The HR Profile Viewer [sn_hr_core.profile_reader] role is the minimum required to view confidential data associated with the HR Profile. This read-only role provides access to confidential HR profile fields without the ability to modify them. HR Admin (A) and HR Basic (C) also have access but are not the minimum, and ESC Admin (B) is for portal administration.

questions.stem: Which ServiceNow feature is used to create pulse surveys?
questions.explanation: Listening Posts is the ServiceNow feature used to create pulse surveys. It provides the capability to design, schedule, and deliver short employee pulse surveys to gauge sentiment and gather feedback. Listening Posts integrates with campaigns for delivery and analytics for tracking responses and trends.

questions.stem: What is the role of Trigger conditions in activity sets?

options.text: It defines specific employees to the activity set targets.
It defines when the activity set should be initiated.
It defines order number for the activity set.
It defines the relationships between fields in various tables.

questions.explanation: Trigger conditions in activity sets define when the activity set should be initiated. Each activity set has a trigger type (Immediate, Date, Other Activity Sets, Advanced, Condition, or Combination) and associated conditions that determine when its activities become active within the lifecycle event process.

questions.stem: Which plugin is recommended when upgrading from the global version of HR to the scoped version?

options.text: Human Resources Scoped App: Employee Relations [com.sn_hr_employee_relations]
Human Resources Scoped App: Data Migration [com.sn_hr_migration]
Human Resources Scoped App: Lifecycle Events [com.sn_hr_lifecycle_events]

questions.explanation: The Human Resources Scoped App: Data Migration [com.sn_hr_migration] plugin is recommended when upgrading from the global version of HR to the scoped version. This plugin handles the migration of data and configurations from the legacy global HR tables to the new scoped HR application tables, ensuring data integrity during the transition.

questions.stem: Which portal allows employees to submit ethical violation complaints?
questions.explanation: The Employee Center allows employees to submit ethical violation complaints. Employee Center provides access to HR services including anonymous complaint submission forms and ethical violation reporting. It serves as the employee self-service portal where various HR requests, including sensitive employee relations matters, can be submitted.

questions.stem: When creating a new Lifecycle Event activity set, what happens when the audience field is set as empty?

options.text: The activity set applies to all employees.
The activity set applies for a specific group of people.
The activity set will not apply to a specific group of people.
The activity set will not apply to any employees.

questions.explanation: When the Audience field is left empty on a Lifecycle Event activity set, the activity set applies to all employees. No audience filter means no restrictions — every subject person of that lifecycle event type will have the activities triggered. To limit activities to specific employee groups, you must explicitly set audience criteria.

questions.stem: Which base instance application delivers the results of current state metrics?
questions.explanation: HR Dashboards and Reports is the base instance application that delivers results of current state metrics. It provides pre-built dashboards with real-time data on HR case volumes, resolution times, agent workload, and other operational metrics. Performance Analytics (D) provides trend analysis over time, while Dashboards and Reports shows current state.

questions.stem: After an HRSD implementation, what capabilities exist for a System Administrator attempting to impersonate an HR member once the HR Admin role has been removed? (Choose two.)

options.text: System Admin can grant scoped HR roles.
System Admin can view HR Cases and confidential profile information.
System Admin cannot grant scoped HR roles.
System Admin cannot view HR Cases and confidential profile information.

questions.explanation: After removing the HR Admin role from the Admin role, a System Administrator attempting to impersonate an HR member will find: they cannot grant scoped HR roles (C) because HR role assignment requires the HR Admin role, and they cannot view HR Cases and confidential profile information (D) because the ACLs require HR-scoped roles that the Admin no longer inherits.

questions.stem: Which application delivers employees an omni-channel learning experience to enable timely access to the correct learning?
questions.explanation: Learning Posts delivers employees an omni-channel learning experience to enable timely access to the correct learning content. It provides curated learning content delivered through the Employee Center, email, and other channels, helping employees find relevant training materials, articles, and resources based on their role and needs.

questions.stem: If an HR Service needs to be accessible to employees on the Employee Center, which field must be completed on the HR Service record?
questions.explanation: For an HR Service to be accessible on the Employee Center, the Record Producer field must be completed on the HR Service record. The Record Producer creates the employee-facing catalog item that generates an HR Case when submitted. Without a Record Producer, the service exists only for internal HR use and is not visible to employees on the portal.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of Journey designer?

options.text: It tracks the progress of Lifecycle Events and onboarding cases using the dashboards.
It passes information from the lifecycle event case to a child case or task
It manages the dependencies of activities within an activity set.
It combines Lifecycle Event cases and Journey Accelerator action plans.

questions.explanation: Journey Designer combines Lifecycle Event cases and Journey Accelerator action plans into a unified employee experience. It merges automated lifecycle event processes with personalized journey plans, providing a comprehensive view of all onboarding or transition activities in one place. It does not track dashboard progress (A), pass field information (B), or manage activity dependencies (C).

questions.stem: Which HRSD application synchronizes ServiceNow with external HR systems?
questions.explanation: HR Integrations is the HRSD application that synchronizes ServiceNow with external HR systems. It provides the framework for configuring integration sources, schema mappings, and data transformation between ServiceNow HRSD and third-party HR applications like Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or ADP.

questions.stem: Which content delivery feature will allow a user to deliver messages to employees and invite them to a meeting where survey results will be shared?
questions.explanation: Campaigns is the content delivery feature that allows delivering messages to employees and inviting them to meetings where survey results will be shared. Campaigns provide multi-channel communication capabilities including email, notifications, and scheduled content delivery. They can be used to drive survey participation and share outcomes.

questions.stem: Which learning task template field allows creation of the short description and description in one or more languages?
questions.explanation: The Global descriptions for translations field on the learning task template allows creation of the short description and description in one or more languages. This field supports multilingual content by enabling administrators to provide translated versions of task descriptions, supporting international employee populations.

questions.stem: With the I18N: Knowledge Management Internationalization Plugin v2 enabled, how are translated Knowledge articles associated with each other so that the user is presented with the article in the selected language?
questions.explanation: With the I18N Knowledge Management Internationalization Plugin v2, translated Knowledge articles are associated through the Translated Versions related list. This list on the Knowledge article form shows all translated versions and their languages, allowing the system to serve the correct language version to each user automatically.

questions.stem: Which base instance application delivers the results of current state metrics?
questions.explanation: HR Reports is the base instance application that delivers results of current state metrics. It provides standard reports showing current HR operational data like case counts, resolution rates, and workload distribution. Performance Analytics (B) is for trend analysis over time, while HR Reports shows point-in-time current state data.

questions.stem: Which scoped table is an extension of the Task table and allow only users with approved roles to access it?
questions.explanation: HR Core Case [sn_hr_core_case] is the scoped table that extends the Task table and restricts access to users with approved HR roles. As a scoped application table, it inherits Task functionality while enforcing application scope security. The other options are plugin names (A, B, D), not scoped tables.

questions.stem: Which feature prevents editing or purging of employee documents based on an HR Profile?
questions.explanation: Legal Holds prevent editing or purging of employee documents based on an HR Profile. When a legal hold is placed on an HR Profile or Document Type, the system prevents any modification or deletion of affected documents to ensure compliance with legal requirements. Retention Policy (A) controls when documents are purged, not prevents it during legal matters.

questions.stem: Which field on the Knowledge form categorizes the Knowledge record within the Knowledge base?
questions.explanation: The Category picker field on the Knowledge form categorizes the Knowledge record within the Knowledge base. It allows authors to select from predefined categories that organize articles into logical groups, making it easier for users to browse and find relevant content. Knowledge taxonomy (B), Article organizer (C), and Topic categories (D) are not standard field names.

questions.stem: In terms of bulk cases what Status label is given to a User that no longer matches the criteria defined in User Segments?
questions.explanation: In bulk cases, a user that no longer matches the criteria defined in User Segments receives the Excluded status label. When user segment conditions change or an employee's attributes no longer match, they are excluded from the bulk case operation. Included (C) means they still match, Inactive (B) refers to user status, and Duplicate (A) is for repeated records.

questions.stem: What type of information does the HR Profile contain?
questions.explanation: The HR Profile contains personal employee data such as emergency contacts, marital status, and other HR-specific confidential information. While the question has similar wording to Q5, here option C specifically says 'Personal employee data' which is the core purpose of the HR Profile table. User ID and department info (D) is stored on the User table, not the HR Profile.

questions.stem: What happens when a cross-scope attempt is executed?

options.text: The record is automatically added to the Restricted Caller Access Privileges table
The record is automatically set to caller tracking
The Read record status is set to requested before the system will allow the script to run
The record status is automatically set to allowed

questions.explanation: When a cross-scope attempt is executed, the Read record status is set to requested before the system allows the script to run. The Restricted Caller Access framework intercepts the call, creates a record with requested status, and the administrator must then approve (set to Allowed) or deny the access. The record is not automatically set to tracked or allowed.

questions.stem: What are the advantages of removing the HR Admin role from the system Admin role after the HR Implementation tasks have been completed? (Choose two.)

options.text: Confidential HR data is only accessible to users with an HR role
HR has control over further HR configurations
System Admin can still grant scoped HR roles
System admin can view HR Cases and confidential profile information

questions.explanation: The advantages of removing the HR Admin role from Admin are: confidential HR data is only accessible to users with an HR role (A) protecting sensitive employee information, and HR has control over further HR configurations (B) giving HR autonomy over their application. System Admin can still grant HR roles (C) via user_admin but this is a capability, not an advantage of removal. Option D describes a risk, not an advantage.

questions.stem: What are the functions of a journey template owner? (Choose three.)

options.text: Restrict inter-departmental transfer of sensitive case details
Manage the order and flow of the journey stages and tasks
Create task templates for their audience in a simple user-friendly experience
Message new hire to welcome them to the team
Change only the task templates that they own

questions.explanation: Journey template owner functions include: managing the order and flow of journey stages and tasks (B), creating task templates for their audience in a user-friendly experience (C), and changing only the task templates that they own (E). Restricting inter-departmental transfers (A) is a security function, and messaging new hires (D) is a mentor/manager function, not template owner functions.

questions.stem: What are the configurations for the activity set that is triggered by a date field to not trigger if the date field is empty?

options.text: Add a script to the activity set definition
Select the ignore empty date box.

questions.explanation: To prevent a date-triggered activity set from triggering when the date field is empty, select the Ignore empty date box. This checkbox on the activity set configuration tells the system to skip the activity set entirely if the trigger date field has no value, preventing unnecessary activities from being created.

questions.stem: What does the template field referenced on the HR Service record do?

options.text: Populate fields on a Journey task
Populate fields on the HR Profile
Populate fields on the HR Case record

questions.explanation: The Template field referenced on the HR Service record populates fields on the HR Case record. When a case is created for that service, the linked HR Template automatically fills in case attributes like assignment group, skills, priority, and other fields, ensuring consistent case setup across similar requests.

questions.stem: Which option allows a user to make a copy of a campaign?
questions.explanation: Clone Campaign is the option that allows a user to make a copy of an existing campaign. This creates a duplicate with the same configuration, content, and audience settings that can be modified for a new campaign. User Campaign (A), Copy Campaign (B), and Update Campaign (C) are not the correct option names in ServiceNow.

questions.stem: As part of the implementation for an HR Enterprise customer, a new Lifecycle Event for a leave of absence was created. What additional item must be configured in order to initiate the leave of absence Lifecycle Event process for an employee?

options.text: An acceptance from an HR Agent

questions.explanation: An HR Service must be configured to initiate the leave of absence Lifecycle Event process. The HR Service acts as the trigger mechanism — when an employee or HR professional creates a case using the HR Service tied to the leave of absence lifecycle event, the system initiates the full LE process with its activity sets and trigger conditions.

questions.stem: If the customer has enabled Lifecycle Enterprise, in which Application Scope should they create new Lifecycle Events that will task teams throughout their organization?
questions.explanation: For Lifecycle Events Enterprise that task teams throughout the organization (cross-departmental), new lifecycle events should be created in the Human Resources Scoped App: Integrations scope. LE Enterprise enables cross-departmental tasking, and the Integrations scope provides the framework for extending lifecycle event activities beyond the HR department to IT, Facilities, and other teams.

questions.stem: Which of the following applications allow administrators to create templates that enable managers to develop transition plans for employees?
questions.explanation: Journey Accelerator allows administrators to create templates that enable managers to develop transition plans for employees. It provides pre-built plan templates with stages and tasks that managers can customize for individual employees during onboarding, role changes, or other transitions. Lifecycle Events (A) automates processes, while Journey Accelerator focuses on manager-driven planning.

questions.stem:
The customer you are implementing has purchased HR Service Delivery Enterprise which includes Enterprise Onboarding and Transitions.

Which of the following plugins must be activated to enable Lifecycle Events?

options.text: Human Resources Scoped App: Lifecycle Events for Enterprise [com.sn_hr_lifecycle_ent]

questions.explanation: The Human Resources Scoped App: Lifecycle Events for Enterprise [com.sn_hr_lifecycle_ent] plugin must be activated to enable Lifecycle Events Enterprise. This plugin extends the base Lifecycle Events capabilities with cross-departmental tasking, enabling work assignment to teams outside HR. It is distinct from the standard LE plugin (com.sn_hr_lifecycle_events).

questions.stem: Which HRSD application limits agent tasking only within the HR department?
questions.explanation: Lifecycle Events (standard, not Enterprise) limits agent tasking only within the HR department. The base Lifecycle Events plugin restricts task assignment to HR groups and agents only. Lifecycle Events Enterprise (C) extends tasking across departments. HR Performance Analytics (B) is for metrics, and Employee Center (D) is a portal, neither limit tasking.

questions.stem: What method is used to set policies that determines how long documents are retained and who is covered?

options.text: Create a new policy trough COE Security
Create a new policy using ACLs
Go through Employee Documents > Document Type
Go through HR Service Template > Document Type

questions.explanation: Document retention policies are set through Employee Documents > Document Type. Each Document Type record includes retention settings that define how long documents are retained and the criteria for which employees are covered. This centralizes document lifecycle management at the document type level, making it easy to apply consistent policies.

questions.stem: Which ServiceNow security feature allows access to applications and modules?
questions.explanation: Roles are the ServiceNow security feature that allows access to applications and modules. Roles define what navigation modules, applications, and features a user can see and interact with. Scoped Application (A) provides isolation between application scopes, User Authentication (D) controls login access, and Simple Security (C) is not a standard ServiceNow term.

questions.stem: When testing a lifecycle event, you deselected certain cards. When running the test, what does the system do with the activities that were deselected?

options.text: The activity wit be skipped for all future lifecycle events
The activity will be created and automatically cancelled for the test
The activity will be created and must be manually closed for the test
The activity will be skipped for the test

questions.explanation: When testing a lifecycle event and certain cards are deselected, those activities will be skipped for the test. The test mode allows administrators to selectively run certain activities while bypassing others, making it easier to test specific parts of a lifecycle event without executing the entire process. The deselection only affects the current test run.

questions.stem: Which plugin allows agent tasking only within the HR department?

options.text: Human Resources Scoped App: Lifecycle Events [com.sn_hr_lifecycle_events]
Human Resources Scoped App: Lifecycle Events for Enterprise [com.sn_hr_lifecycle_ent]
Human Resources Scoped App: Employee Relations [com.sn_hr_employee_relations]

questions.explanation: The Human Resources Scoped App: Lifecycle Events [com.sn_hr_lifecycle_events] plugin allows agent tasking only within the HR department. The standard LE plugin restricts task assignment to HR groups, while LE Enterprise (C) extends tasking across departments. Integrations (A) is for external system connections, and Employee Relations (D) is for ER case management.

questions.stem: Which feature enables agents to have discussions about their work in the Next Experience user interface?
questions.explanation: The Sidebar overview in the Next Experience user interface enables agents to have discussions about their work. The sidebar provides contextual conversations, collaboration tools, and work notes in a persistent panel that agents can use while working on cases and tasks without leaving their current view.

questions.stem: What role, at a minimum, is required to configure an HR integration source?
questions.explanation: The Integrations Admin [sn_hr_integrations.admin] role is the minimum required to configure an HR integration source. This role provides access to the HR Integrations application scope including Sources, Schema Mappings, and Web Services modules. HR Admin and HR Manager roles do not include integration configuration permissions.

questions.stem: Which application is used to analyze trends, patterns, and data on the Team Insights page?
questions.explanation: Manager Hub is the application used to analyze trends, patterns, and data on the Team Insights page. Manager Hub provides managers with a centralized workspace for team management including team insights, proactive prompts, journey oversight, and action items. The Team Insights page specifically provides analytical views of team data and trends.

questions.stem: Which feature allows HR Administrators to define when surveys are sent?
questions.explanation: Listening Posts allows HR Administrators to define when surveys are sent. It provides scheduling capabilities for pulse survey delivery, including frequency, timing, and audience targeting. Survey Designer (A) creates the survey content, Assessments (B) is the underlying framework, and Trigger Conditions (D) is for lifecycle events, not survey scheduling.

questions.stem: Which feature of Lifecycle Events will revert an already completed activity such as the workplace setup?
questions.explanation: The Rescind Activity Set reverts already completed activities in a lifecycle event, such as workplace setup. When enabled on a lifecycle event, the rescind activity set allows HR to cancel and undo activities if the event needs to be reversed. Each rescind activity can target a specific completed activity for reversal.

questions.stem: The HR Integrations application works very similarly to any other integration in the ServiceNow platform, however its application scope only allows users with the appropriate HR roles to access its information. In which Application Scope is HR Integrations?
questions.explanation: HR Integrations is in the Human Resources: Integrations application scope. This scoped application restricts access to HR integration configuration to users with the sn_hr_integrations.admin role, maintaining security while allowing integration management. It is separate from Core (D) and unrelated to Restricted Caller Access (A) or Openframe (B).

questions.stem: Which module allows administrators to restrict access to specific HR Services without creating ACL records?
questions.explanation: The COE Security Configuration module (also known as COE ACL Configuration) allows administrators to restrict access to specific HR Services without creating ACL records. It provides a user-friendly interface for defining which groups can access which COEs and services. Client-Side Masking (A) and Encryption (D) are different security mechanisms.

questions.stem: If Advanced is selected for an Activity Set Trigger Condition, what additional field(s) become visible?
questions.explanation: When Advanced is selected for an Activity Set Trigger Condition, the Trigger script field becomes visible. The Advanced trigger type allows administrators to write custom JavaScript that evaluates complex conditions to determine when the activity set should be initiated, providing maximum flexibility beyond the standard trigger types.

questions.stem: Which feature allows a user to transfer tasks related to Employee Relocation Approvals to another user?
questions.explanation: Granular Delegation allows a user to transfer tasks related to Employee Relocation Approvals to another user. It enables targeted task delegation for specific date ranges, allowing an employee to designate someone else to handle their approval tasks while they are unavailable. Audience (A) is for LE activities, and Rescind (D) is for reverting activities.

questions.stem: Which application is used to send prompts to managers and employees in their flow of work?
questions.explanation: Proactive Prompts is the application used to send prompts to managers and employees in their flow of work. It delivers contextual nudges, reminders, and actionable insights directly within the user's workspace (such as Manager Hub). Proactive Prompts can trigger based on events, dates, or conditions to drive timely manager actions.

questions.stem: How are conditions applied to all HR services when configuring a record on the COE Security Configuration module?

options.text: Select the 'Applies to all services' box

questions.explanation: The default caller access option for HR tables is Caller Restriction. When HR scoped applications are installed, the Restricted Caller Access framework defaults to restricting cross-scope calls to HR tables.
